name: 53215 · Milwaukee, WI
findings: ZIP 53215 (Milwaukee) has 90 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53215 (Milwaukee) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53215 (Milwaukee) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 21 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
